clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Mitsuwa mourns the trolls slain on their journey through Ashenvale. He calls on Horde champions to recover their stolen charms.

Mitsuwa serves the Horde at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, alongside Marukai. Thistlefur furbolgs of northern Ashenvale ambushed and slaughtered a group of traveling trolls bound for the outpost. Mitsuwa sees their deaths as a grievous offense. He sends warriors to the Thistlefur dens to reclaim the stolen troll charms and honor the spirits of his kin.
